correctness.rationale: Use Archer–Graves Theorem 1.2 exact A(z)=P(z)(F(z)+G(z)). Strict Catalan coefficient estimates keep P analytic beyond |z|=1/2 and G analytic there; F=2(1−z)/(1−2z+sqrt(1−4z²)) has sole boundary singularities ±1/2. At +1/2 its leading nonanalytic term is P_+/sqrt2 (1−2z)^−1/2; at −1/2 it is −3sqrt2 P_-/4 (1+2z)^1/2. Singularity transfer yields a_n=K2^n n^−1/2(1+(α+β(−1)^n)/n+O(n^−2)), K=P_+/sqrt(2π), β=3P_-/(4P_+)>0. Adjacent multiplication gives T_n=(−1)^n(3P_+P_-/(2π))4^n/n²+O(4^n/n³), not a claimed finite threshold. Independently generated 90 coefficients; first 16 matched primary table, parity held n=8..89, constant independently evaluated 1.9514080909277811.
